dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Everyone looks so happy... The experience is different from gazing at the starry sky, but still... what a sight to behold.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It's me. Layla just managed to submit her paper, so she's resting now.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It's a pity she missed this year's Parade. But, her work ethic is truly commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I'll take a picture to capture this moment and put it on her desk.
